svg.title: Two routing measures for the same D3-C boards
svg.desc: With Opus 5.5, PCBRouteAgent completed an average of 94.9% of required connections per board. Four of the ten two-layer boards had full connectivity and zero error-level violations under PCBWorld rules.

g.font-family: Arial, Helvetica, PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif
g.text: Zero error-level violations under PCBWorld rules.
